# Should under-7s play festivals, not fixtures?

## Question

Should our youngest teams play in festivals with no results, or in fixtures with league tables like the older teams?

## Current Answer

Festivals for under-7s and under-8s, agreed at the [[season-launch-meeting-2026-08-18]]. Northmere FA requires it for those ages anyway ([[northmere-fa-league-handbook-2026-27]]); we also chose to keep the under-9s in friendly fixtures without our own tables.

## Reasoning kept for next time

A few parents asked in 2025 for "proper matches" so their children could see progress. Tom Ashworth's answer at the meeting was that every child plays most of every game in a festival, and that the children who struggle at 6 are not the ones who struggle at 12. The reading on the [[wikipedia-relative-age-effect]] backs him: early results reward whoever was born earliest in the year. See [[mini-football-festival]].
